kind.description: item kind: part (catalog/parts.json), material (catalog/materials.json, or a material record living in parts.json), tool (catalog/tools.json). Absent means part.

mpn.description: manufacturer part number where recorded, else null

name.description: display name; required for material/tool entries whose record does not exist yet (a run gathers against a stub under this name and apply creates the record)

part_id.description: catalog item id (a part id, material id or tool id, per the entry's kind)

ttl_seconds.description: per-class freshness: price/stock short, specs long, datasheet by revision
